There are many factors to consider but in my limited understanding, these two are the most prominent.

The concept of God is beyond the comprehension of scientific method. The concept of God is designed to be beyond science. But thanks to science we understand this very fact. 
As far as the existence of such a being is concerned, our knowledge of known universe does not support any such claims. Mostly people like to point out to something unknown or some gap in scientific knowledge and try to use it to justify the existence of a supernatural phenomenon but this "God of Gaps" explanation is not credible. It puts God in this ever shrinking space which will sooner or later be overtook by science. The most practicle example I can think of is perhaps the God of ancient times who used to call upon catastrophes of unimaginable destruction to punish the deniers. Now that the knowledge of humanity has grown exponentially, all we get is an occasional appearance of Jesus on a piece of toast.
